segments.name: Community banking
segments.description: Accepts deposits and originates loans, including commercial and residential real estate, for customers through various delivery channels.
segments.evidence: The Company's financial results are considered to be aggregated into one reportable operating segment with revenue derived from the business of community banking.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay interest on loans and fees for deposit accounts and other banking services.
revenueModel.evidence: The community banking segment derives revenues mainly from interest income on loans to customers, investment securities held and fees and income related to the services listed above.
